packageRules.description: `engines.node` states the range this repo supports, not a version to track. Pinning it to a single release makes `npm ci --engine-strict` reject every runtime the workflows actually use (Node 24) and every future patch of the pinned line.

customManagers.description: The published Remote Compose players the export driver's browser guards run against (`RC_PLAYERS_VERSION` in ci.yml). Both zips come from the rc-players release this BOM names.
